language: English for all model-visible owned material and generated prose; exact source citations remain verbatim.
development: One new D analysis, two fresh independent AUTO baselines, one tool-free fresh reflection, two independent experience revalidations. No old experience or test feedback.
admission: At least one evidenced target/overall relation improves relative to AUTO; no unsupported policy; record all losses. Not a both-PASS gate.
tests: After library freeze, each T independently analyzed once; existing conservative router selects zero or one entry. A/B share one fixed Contract, original source, requirements and tools; only routed body is added. Two independent repeats per arm.
empty_library_or_all_pass: Both D AUTO PASS: no experience generated and stop; unsupported candidate or no development improvement: stop before tests. No case replacement.
normal_failure: Continue fixed next slot. Complete valid final candidates can fail the original scorer due to source syntax/runtime/protocol errors; preserve the original vectors and runtime traces.
stop: First service/isolation/archive/meter/input anomaly, unresolved core semantic conflict, or invalid output: preserve partial/raw data and stop without retry or extra candidate.
no_extra_calls: No GEPA, judge, connection preflight, retry, replacement or next round.
